limitations: Bounded randomized agreement with a saved solver is not proof of semantic completeness.
rule: On a 10x10 background-7 canvas, count the 8-connected (diagonal-inclusive) objects of each legend colour; output a 5-wide bar chart whose height is the largest count, with a bottom-anchored bar of that colour's count in its fixed column (5->0, 2->1, 8->2, 9->3, 6->4).
scope: Supported: fixed 10x10 size and background 7 (intrinsic to the task), random subsets of 2..5 legend colours, per-colour object counts 1..6 with the maximum in 2..6, a varied shape library (singles, dominoes, diagonal chains that only connect diagonally, pluses, X's, rings, blocks, L's, T's, lines up to 9 long, random blobs) at random positions, and different-colour objects that may touch. Deliberately not supported: other grid sizes/backgrounds, non-legend colours (the archived solver would let them affect the output height), and same-colour objects touching diagonally (which would merge into one object).
constraints: Every input is exactly 10x10 with background 7 and only legend colours 5, 2, 8, 9, 6.
Objects of the same colour never share an 8-neighbourhood, so each placed object is exactly one diagonally-connected component.
Objects never overlap cells; different colours may be adjacent since counting is per colour.
At least one colour has two or more objects, so the output height is at least 2 and the output is never a trivial one-row chart.
generate(objects=...) raises ValueError if the supplied objects overlap, touch same-colour objects, or use non-legend colours.
known_limitations: Grid size (10x10), background (7) and the colour-to-column legend are fixed because they are intrinsic to the task.
Placement uses bounded retries; with many objects the sampler falls back to small shapes, so scenes with 10+ objects are dominated by 1-4 cell shapes.
Random shape placement may produce different-colour objects touching each other, which is allowed by the rule but not required to look exactly like the originals.
Fixture replay requires explicit per-object cell lists rather than higher-level shape descriptors.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback

checks: Latent object counts determine bars; 8-connectivity includes diagonal chains
Same-colour objects cannot touch; different colours may touch
Fixed 10x10 input and colour-column legend documented as current scope
No archived solver import or file I/O
